status: PROPOSED - art suggestion, nothing wired in-engine
sheet_layout: horizontal strip, frames left->right, frame_size each

_sway_masks.note: 8-bit L mask, same size as the *_sway frames (static sprite padded); 0 = pinned, 255 = full swing. Use with a CanvasItem shader on the STATIC sprite instead of the flipbook (see README).

bird.note: flight flap loop; fly across the screen at 60-90 px/s at 1x, high above the ground; pair with bird_shadow on the ground offset down-right

bird_shadow.note: soft ground shadow for birds (draw on the ground layer, offset ~+40,+70 px at 1x from the bird)

bush_a_shadow_sway.anchor: frame top-left = top-left of the matching bush_a_sway frame (i.e. bottom-centre anchor - (26, 36) px at 1x); draw on the ground layer under all props
bush_a_shadow_sway.note: v5 cast shadow that moves with the canopy: frame i is the projection of sway frame i (light from the top-left, shear 0.62, squash 0.30, soft 2.2 px).
